testsuite.name: taxonomy.diagnostics.DiagnosticsBundleTest

testcase.name: recordProposalMemo lands every proposal_memo key in run_manifest()
the config file is copied verbatim so the bundle is self-contained()
open on an unwritable location does not throw()
writes after close are ignored rather than throwing()
open creates the promised files with headers()
manifest records provenance and is patched at close()
an unwired producer leaves a header-only file and the manifest says so()
floats never use a comma decimal separator()
recordAnchorFree writes true and false explicitly()
recordConstructionOrder writes the seed, and null when absent()
proposal rows carry the binding value in the reason, and group by site()
